summary: @or-sdk/markdowner preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes a 727 KB obfuscated payload
details: Package advertises itself as a Markdown utility. Its package.json declares a `preinstall` script `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated bundle: obfuscator.io-style shuffled string-array with a rotator function, hex-suffixed identifier names, and a base64-alphabet decoder. Fetching a second JS runtime specifically to execute an opaque bundle at install time — under a runtime chosen to sidestep Node-based tooling — is a dropper pattern, not the behavior of a Markdown utility. The declared purpose (Markdown processing) does not require a downloaded alternate runtime or a large obfuscated blob at install. The obfuscation prevents any assurance that the executed code does not perform credential harvesting, exfiltration, or persistence on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
